data.title: PAYE/PIT under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (bands 0/15/18/21/23/25, N800,000 exemption) — from 2026

provenance.as_passed: Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (signed 26 June 2025), Fourth Schedule (PIT rates) and s.30 (reliefs); effective 1 January 2026
provenance.source_citation: Nigeria Tax Act 2025 (nass.gov.ng gazette copy, https://nass.gov.ng/documents/download/11249); PwC Nigeria individual tax summaries (https://taxsummaries.pwc.com/nigeria/individual/taxes-on-personal-income); JTB Personal Income Tax Guidelines 2026 (https://www.jtb.gov.ng/assets/2026-pit-guidelines-TJG3n9-T.pdf)
